limits: Source geometry only; no actual image views or target-scale pixel conclusion.
Port checks cover endpoint-used public circle centers only, not circle radius/hitarea, painted rounded corner, stroke, marker or glyph bounds.
Self-route tests omit intentional adjacent bends and zero-length segments; all inter-route overlap/contact/backplate warnings in original case reports remain.
Paper SVG scope, not workspace grid; no capture synchronization/live acquisition, runtime/model fidelity, performance or human acceptance certification.
